description: Source code implementing disk access backend functions for ext2 filesystem in Zephyr RTOS, including device size, read/write operations, and initialization.

methods.name: disk_access_device_size
methods.description: Calculates total device size based on sector count and size.

methods.name: disk_access_write_size
methods.description: Returns the sector size for write operations.

methods.name: disk_read
methods.description: Performs a synchronized read from disk with retries.

methods.name: disk_write
methods.description: Performs a synchronized write to disk with retries.

methods.name: disk_prepare_range
methods.description: Prepares and validates the range of sectors for read/write.

methods.name: disk_access_read_block
methods.description: Reads a block from ext2 filesystem.

methods.name: disk_access_write_block
methods.description: Writes a block to ext2 filesystem.

methods.name: ext2_init_disk_access_backend
methods.description: Initializes disk access backend for ext2 filesystem.
